# UltradianDrift

> Work in sync with your natural rhythm.

UltradianDrift (your natural ~90-minute focus rhythm, allowed to drift) is a free, browser-only
task tracker for the way your energy actually moves — not the way a clock says it should. It syncs tasks and focus sessions with the
body's natural ultradian rhythm: the ~90-minute waves when people are genuinely sharp, followed
by the rest they need. **Flowtime** lets users ride a full wave of deep, open-ended work and stop
when their energy dips; **Pomodoro** is available when they want a structured forcing function
against procrastination. No account, no subscription, no ads, no tracking: all data lives in the
user's browser.

## Key features

- Flowtime focus aligned to the natural ultradian rhythm (count-up, stop when your energy dips)
- Pomodoro timer with configurable work/break cycles and long-break cadence
- Urgent/important (Eisenhower) task board with priorities 1–5
- Recurring routines: daily, work days (Mon–Fri), weekly, or monthly, with a scheduled time
- Natural-language quick-add (`#tags`, `!priority`, "tomorrow 9am")
- Quick tasks batched into one continuous focus run
- Plan for today or defer to a later date; overdue tasks are surfaced clearly
- Tags, optional time estimates, and task descriptions
- Session history, focus dashboard (trend and weekday-rhythm charts, quadrant/tag breakdowns),
  and focus streak
- Drift-free timers computed from wall-clock timestamps
- Browser notifications and optional sound cues (with preview)
- 100% offline-capable: data in localStorage, JSON export/import, CSV import, Markdown export,
  automatic backups, and daily snapshots
- Installable PWA; dark forest-green theme with a light "day" mode

## How it works

Users add tasks to an urgent/important board, mark daily routines as recurring, then start a
Flowtime count-up or a timed Pomodoro session on any task. When their energy dips, they finish
and take a real break. Completed sessions are recorded in history with notes, and the dashboard
shows focus totals by day, weekday rhythm, quadrant, and tag.

## Tech

TypeScript, Vite, and vanilla DOM — no runtime dependencies. Single-page, front-end-only by
design. Open the app, add a task, start focusing.
